issues: No sign of gaming the measurement: no file or network access, no pasted coordinates, and the packing is still computed by the script.
No bug that would make the result meaningless. The new annealing step only replaces the incumbent's packing if the polished result has a strictly larger LP-feasible sum. The 1e-10 shrink is kept.

Time limits: the random-restart phase is cut from 150 s to 110 s and annealing runs until 180 s. The final _polish call after that has no time limit; it will probably still finish well before the 4-minute margin, but this is not guaranteed.
Loop stopping depends on the clock, so results may not repeat exactly (about 1e-6 variation). This is expected and does not affect validity.

There is one run per arm. Both scores are -2.636, so the difference is 0 and z = 0. With n=1 the variance can't actually be estimated. There is no evidence of improvement, so the provisional 'reject' agrees with the numbers.
